items.title: Stephen Miller named as new White House chief of staff
items.abstract: President Trump has named his controversial deputy Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff, following the departure of Susie Wiles after Republican midterm losses. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.
items.zh_title: 特朗普任命强硬派斯蒂芬·米勒出任白宫幕僚长
items.zh_summary: 特朗普在中期选举失利后调整人事，任命其副手、移民政策强硬派斯蒂芬·米勒接替离职的苏西·怀尔斯出任白宫幕僚长。

items.title: Trump confirms US strikes in Iran, insists ‘it’s not a war’
items.abstract: US President Donald Trump said America has carried out ‘minor strikes’ on Iran’s Qeshm Island.
items.zh_title: 特朗普证实美军对伊朗实施空袭但坚称非开战
items.zh_summary: 美国总统特朗普证实，美军对伊朗格什姆岛实施了“轻微打击”，但他坚称这并非一场战争，此举引发各方高度关注。

items.title: Ukraine: Russia hits Kyiv with airstrikes ahead of trilateral talks
items.abstract: The strikes hit a major bridge and energy facilities in the Kyiv region. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused Moscow of trying to "push" Ukraine "into a blackout" ahead of talks in Abu Dhabi.
items.zh_title: 俄军在三方会谈前对基辅发动空袭
items.zh_summary: 俄罗斯在三方会谈前夕空袭基辅地区的重要桥梁和能源设施；乌克兰总统泽连斯基指责莫斯科企图以此对乌施压。

items.title: Democrats set sights on Elon Musk probe after midterm wins, but Pritzker draws a surprising line
items.abstract: Rep. Jamie Raskin, D-Md., says he feels "pretty certain" at least one committee will investigate DOGE, calling Elon Musk's cost-cutting effort a catastrophe.
items.zh_title: 民主党拟对马斯克主导的政府效率部展开调查
items.zh_summary: 众议员拉斯金表示，国会委员会极可能对马斯克领导的政府效率部（DOGE）削减政府开支的行动展开正式调查。

items.title: California rejects billionaire tax proposal in win for executives, Newsom
items.abstract: California voters are rejecting a proposal to impose a wealth tax on billionaire residents, marking a major win for tech and business executives, who spent hundreds of millions against the measure, according to a projection from Decision Desk HQ (DDHQ). According to DDHQ’s analysis, 54 percent voted against the measure
items.zh_title: 加州选民投票否决向亿万富翁征收财富税提案
items.zh_summary: 加州选民否决了对富豪征税的提案，这标志着科技与商界高管以及反对该提议的加州州长纽森取得了一项重大政治胜利。

items.title: Texas mayor instructs police to limit co-operation with ICE
items.abstract: There has been months of public outcry in Houston after an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officer fatally shot a man who was driving to work.
items.zh_title: 休斯敦市长下令限制警方与联邦移民局合作
items.zh_summary: 一名移民局特工枪杀涉驾车逃逸男子引发数月公众抗议后，休斯敦市长指示警方限制与联邦移民执法局（ICE）的合作。

items.title: DOJ dismisses lawsuit over California’s 20,000 disputed ballots
items.abstract: The Justice Department (DOJ) requested Friday to dismiss its lawsuit against California, which sought to make the state’s election officials set aside roughly 20,000 ballots for voters the federal government alleged were not U.S. citizens. items.zh_title: 美司法部撤回针对加州两万张争议选票的诉讼
items.zh_summary: 美国司法部主动申请撤销对加利福尼亚州的诉讼，司法部此前曾要求加州选举官员搁置约两万张涉嫌有争议的选票。

items.title: Why Israel’s Ex-Army Chief’s Next Mission Could Be Mission Impossible
items.abstract: Gadi Eisenkot is poised to get a chance to form a new government, replacing Benjamin Netanyahu as prime minister. But the obstacles are formidable.
items.zh_title: 以军前总参谋长艾森科特或组阁替代内塔尼亚胡
items.zh_summary: 以色列前总参谋长加迪·艾森科特有望获得取代内塔尼亚胡出任总理并组建新政府的机会，但当前面临巨大政治阻碍。

items.title: New Zealand Election Kingmaker Emerges With 50% of Vote Counted
items.abstract: New Zealand’s two main parties are neck-and-neck with half the votes counted in the nation’s election, but projections currently show both political blocs are may need the support of the centrist Opportunity Party, which is on track to enter parliament for the first time.
items.zh_title: 新西兰大选计票过半：两大党势均力敌陷胶着
items.zh_summary: 新西兰半数选票清点完毕，执政国家党与工党势均力敌，两派预计均无法单独拿下多数席位，小党派将成为组阁关键。

items.title: Paraguay's president impeached and under house arrest after bank collapse
items.abstract: Santiago Peña was ousted due to a banking crisis which left millions of people unable to access their money.
items.zh_title: 巴拉圭总统因严重银行危机遭参院弹劾并被软禁
items.zh_summary: 因一场导致数百万民众无法提取存款的严重银行业危机，巴拉圭总统培尼亚遭参议院弹劾罢免，并被当局置于软禁之下。

items.title: Pope Leo arrives in Uruguay for first stop on 12-day South America tour
items.abstract: Pope Leo touched down in Uruguay on Friday to begin a 12-day tour of South America that will also see him visit Argentina and Peru. The tour is seen as something of a homecoming for the pontiff who lived in Peru for almost two decades and holds joint US and Peruvian citizenship.
items.zh_title: 教皇利奥抵乌拉圭开启南美行：术后首度出访
items.zh_summary: 教皇利奥抵达乌拉圭，开启为期12天、涵盖阿根廷和秘鲁的南美访问行程，这是其接受肺癌手术后不到一个月的重要出访。

items.title: Trump highlights NASA nuclear-powered Mars spacecraft mission planned for 2028
items.abstract: President Donald Trump announced NASA will launch its first nuclear-powered spacecraft to Mars within two years, aiming to send astronauts to the red planet.
items.zh_title: 特朗普宣布NASA计划发射核动力航天器奔赴火星
items.zh_summary: 特朗普宣布美国国家航空航天局（NASA）将在两年内发射首艘核动力航天器前往火星，目标是未来运送宇航员登陆火星。

items.title: Pakistani astronaut to join China space station's Shenzhou-24 mission
items.zh_title: 巴基斯坦航天员将加入中国神舟二十四号任务
items.zh_summary: 官方消息显示，巴基斯坦航天员将参与中国空间站神舟二十四号任务，成为首位进驻中国空间站的外国航天员。

items.title: China Extends Gold-Buying Streak to Two Years as Prices Drop
items.abstract: China’s central bank added to its gold reserves in October — extending a buying streak to two years — as the precious metal fell almost 7% to end the month below the $4,000-an-ounce support threshold.
items.zh_title: 中国央行趁金价下跌连续第24个月增持黄金
items.zh_summary: 随着国际黄金价格单月回落近7%，中国央行在10月继续扩大黄金储备，将持续买入黄金的势头延长至整整两年。

items.title: AI Data centres face growing backlash
items.abstract: Democrats are also calling for tighter regulation of AI data centres, a concern shared across Europe. In Amsterdam, several hundred activists occupied the site of a planned Microsoft data centre as part of a two-day protest taking place across the continent. Jennie Shin reports.
items.zh_title: 欧美政界与民众对人工智能数据中心反弹加剧
items.zh_summary: 美国民主党议员与欧洲政界要求对AI数据中心收紧监管，荷兰阿姆斯特丹更有数百名示威者抗议其能源消耗与环境影响。

items.title: Air in India’s capital ranked world’s most polluted on eve of Diwali
items.abstract: New Delhi ranked as the world’s ⁠most polluted major ⁠city on Saturday ⁠morning, according to Swiss group IQAir, as the Indian capital faced severe pollution forecasts a day before Diwali, the Hindu festival of lights. items.zh_summary: 空气质量监测机构IQAir数据显示，印度首都新德里在排灯节前夕空气质量严重恶化，被评为全球污染最严重的特大城市。

items.title: James Bond Shocker: Robert Pattinson and Nicholas Hoult Late Contenders for 007 After Auditioning for Denis Villeneuve
items.abstract: As James Bond casting rumors heat up, a couple more A-list actors have entered the mix: Robert Pattinson and Nicholas Hoult were among the stars who screen-tested to play the new 007. items.zh_summary: 随着《詹姆斯·邦德》选角升温，好莱坞一线演员罗伯特·帕丁森与尼古拉斯·霍尔特参与了导演丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦的试镜。

items.zh_summary: 曾执导《少年的你》和《三体》的导演曾国祥受聘执导并执行制作真实罪案剧《Group 41》，该剧聚焦缉毒局案件。
